wing_attachment.note: Border variants translate each wing outward separately; they retain the original pixels and canvas.

outer-border.order: After wings, before crest and badge

wide_concept.note: Wide badge concept; overlay live text. Its proportions need their own ornament positions.

corporation_logos.order: After badge center/frame, before bottom plate and rank

notes: Paths are relative to either the 256/ or 512/ directory.
Stack all layers from one size directory at the same origin and display size.
Replace layers/{metal}/badge.webp with layers/{metal}/badges/{color}.webp for another center color.
Standalone colors/ and framed/ images use a tighter canvas; use the aligned layers/ paths when adding ornaments.
Plates are compact exports with their aspect ratio retained.
Choose a precomposed progression/ or awards/ image for a single image request, or layers/ to build a combination.

expansion_logos.order: After badge center/frame, before bottom plate and rank
